0x10287FB0.name: SqmdDMB_Resolve
0x10287FB0.evidence: Its own strings: the error "*** Error: sqmdDMBResolve: expe..." (0x103B8E8C) when the buffer is not 16-aligned, and the trace "%06ld ... sqmdDMBResolve" (0x103B8E70). It checks the 'DMB' magic, then installs the model's function pointers and calls the texture, shader and updater resolvers.
0x10287FB0.summary: sqmdDMBResolve: checks a loaded 'DMB' model image and fixes up its pointers in place.

0x102886D0.name: SqmdDMB_ResolveTextures
0x102886D0.evidence: Trace string "%06ld ... sqmdDMBResolveTextures" (0x103B9004); per texture it installs function pointers (incl. sqrdTexturePrint), stores the texture into the table at model+0x1C and calls sqgxTextureAdd/sqgxTextureClutAdd.
0x102886D0.summary: sqmdDMBResolveTextures: fixes up and registers each texture of a DMB model.

0x10288950.name: SqmdDMB_ResolveShaders
0x10288950.evidence: Trace string "%06ld ... sqmdDMBResolveShaders" (0x103B90B0); per shader it stores the shader in the table at model+0x2C and, for type 0xF0001, installs function pointers and links its texture slots through SqmdDMB_TextureLink.
0x10288950.summary: sqmdDMBResolveShaders: fixes up each shader of a DMB model and links its textures.

0x10288B70.name: SqmdDMB_TextureLink
0x10288B70.evidence: Error string "*** Error: sqmdDMBTextureLink: t..." (0x103B90E8). Returns entry param_2 of the texture table at model+0x1C when param_2 < count at +0x24; 0xEFBEDDBA (unset marker) and out-of-range indices return 0.
0x10288B70.summary: sqmdDMBTextureLink: turns a texture index into the texture pointer, 0 for the unset marker or an invalid index.
